text:
erin: FYI I opened a small PR to tidy up a console example that mixes trace header names and a JS snippet that references an old cost field. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2176

jack: link up. what's the exact mismatch?
erin: quick summary: some samples use `X-Trace-Id`, others `x-rd-trace`. the node/js snippet still reads `response.costTokens` instead of `usage.tokens`, and there's a stray `kv_prefetch: true` line in the yaml that confuses readers.

li: that `kv_prefetch` bit has bitten users before; removing is 👍. can you also add a tiny example showing server-side trace header propagation (one-line)? helps infra folks.
erin: good call — added a short Grok example showing how to forward `x-rd-trace` from a proxy to the backend header. kept it minimal.

sophie: small product ask: since quickstart is customer-facing, add a 1-line compatibility note for Dedicated customers on pinned SDKs <2.3 so they don't get surprised by telemetry field names.
erin: added the compatibility note and linked the internal migration page.

docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 broken internal link in docs/console/quickstart.md line 148 -> /sdk/telemetry/legacy (404). Suggested replacement: /sdk/migration/telemetry-2-3.

jack: i'll open a tiny site redirect to preserve the old path after this merges.

li: did the cost numbers change much? we should be careful about user expectations.
erin: the table shifted ~4-7% after accounting for the new batching defaults; I added a short "note" under the table explaining the difference. not enough to require a separate changelog entry.

sophie: LGTM modulo CI. jack, can you land the redirect once this merges?

jack: yep opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/site-config/pull/89 for a 301 from /sdk/telemetry/legacy -> /sdk/migration/telemetry-2-3. will ping infra for review.

erin: squashed the fixups and pushed. thanks everyone — will merge after CI goes green and site-config redirect is approved :rocket:
